architecture_fixes: Temporal priors preserve uncertain classification, observed conflict and voted identity; geometry recovery cannot launder identity and retains weak ownership/risk.
Point-supported unknowns mask actual current/previous support in temporal history, never an unobserved extent interior; legacy footprints remain unchanged.
L6 repairs missing occupancy_unknown independently of measured/detector occupancy, preserving provenance and idempotence.

performance.change: Conservative actual-point AABB broadphase versus full-3D object bounds, reference bypass, roundoff guard and exact fallback; cache object rotation and support membership.

performance.models: identical frozen detection and segmentation PBs; no inference
limitations: Shared host and scheduling variation; repeated per-frame distributions, not population P99.
No GEO_ONLY speedup promise or memory reduction claim.
Only NORMAL full payloads are serialized; degraded modes have summary and runner invariants, not full-message equality.
Not end-to-end inference throughput, optimized release performance, GPU fusion or 5-10ms target attainment.

ground_experiment.algorithm: Two deterministic initial estimates, at most three inlier refits each, existing height-band/minimum noncollinear support/slope/residual gates, configured majority >=0.7 by default. No neighbor/history extrapolation; semantic refinement cannot displace independent geometry beyond residual gate.
ground_experiment.reason_not_selected: Ground recall and mixed-component size improve, but additional THING points become geometric ground and measured occupancy changes. Preserved object matches do not establish point-level obstacle safety. No physical-ground/free-space labels justify enabling the tradeoff.

new_frozen_test.metric: unchanged common ROI, class-aware visible-point IoU>=0.5 with >=5-point CAR/PED/CYCLIST GT; not box AP or physical occupancy accuracy
new_frozen_test.historical_original_report_boundary: Old preserved executable used fresh inference; current diagnostic source fingerprints reflect export-time tooling, not a claim old executable was compiled from new source.
